notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Released!
notes.content:
We're releasing a small yet significant update with bugfixes, such as:


 Removed the "Watch Ending" buttons from the extras menu that were left visible by default in from my debugging. Oops.

 Fixed the antigrav zone locking the game or preventing you from saving or dying from falling off the stage. Special thanks to Crysack for the report! This is the fifth time i fix this bug. Will it be the last one? Absolutely not.

 Fixed game not autosaving on quit on the last six levels nor any of the chapter D levels

 Fixed weird interactions spawning from dying, going back into the menu before resetting the level, then loading a save


Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
An update has been released with the following changes:


The final boss is finally playable. Oopsie.

Anna now always appears in the final cutscene.

Added a shadow to the ending credits to make them more readable

You can now replay the final boss once you kill it without the need to reopen the game

Updated Anna's room with objects that were initially cut due to time constraints

Added a completionism achievement for when you get all the other achievements


Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: GROW FLOW 1.0 IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After two and a half years in development, Grow Flow has been fully launched! Changes from the previous version include (but aren't limited to):


Doubled the maximum time you can stay inside of Unsafe Zones
Fixed several saving/loading bugs related to Unsafe Zones
Reformualted how Unsafe Zones were coded - which only means previous saves in chapter 5 levels with Unsafe Zones will not work, so overwrite them!
Fixed several Level Design issues from chapters 3, 4, 5 and 6. This also includes making a few levels easier than previously, and more fun too.
Fixed an inumerable number of issues regarding the Antigrav Zones. No more flying for you!
Actually, i fixed a lot of issues related to Unsafe Zones but i didn't write them all down. I'll give 5 dollars to the person that finds another bug regarding them. They're all gone. Dead.
Antigrav Zone now stops making sound when you change level while inside one of them.


Other than fixes and changes, we have plenty of new inclusions!


Added a new chapter to the game, containing ten levels!
Added three new endings!
Added the two missing extras!
Added a new... enemy?
Added several new secrets!
Hahah i should've written this all down because i'm pretty sure i'm forgetting a thing or two


Thank you, thank you, thank you! Have fun with the game! Don't let anybody tell you how to play! I Sincerely hope you enjoy your time the same way i did while i was doing some final playtesting a couple months ago. And once again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.9.3 Released!
notes.content:
A new Grow Flow update has been released, containing:


 Broken Mirrors wont play sound when attempted to be interacted with anymore

 Fixed Anna's model changing unintentionally in Chapter 1 Level 3 if the player is a true speedrunner

 Significantly improved death plane detection, which means you won't be able to fall forever anymore! The death floor is lower in the majority of levels, but higher on some that had poorly placed ones. This also fixes the three or so levels that would kill you on completion.

 Fixed a bug where the game couldn't properly load achievements, resulting in the game being unplayable from the very beginning. Sorry!

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 Released!
notes.content:
We have uploaded a new patch with the following changes:


 Added par times to Chapter 2 levels

 Added a button that allows you to sync your achievements with Steam and vice versa

 Added Discord rich presence! I had no time to test this whatsoever so hopefully it works flawlessly :D

 Fixed the second Anna animation of levels with two animations not playing after loading a save. Still not great on the first level, but it is the only moment in the game that would require a much more robust and well planned animation system

Removed an *unexpected* element from Chapter 1 Level 5. Whoops!

 Fixed a Normal cube in Chapter 2 Level 4 having twice its intended size

 Made some alterations to the end of Chapter 2 Level 8

 Fixed Chapter 2 Level 8 not saving certain elements

 Repositioned a Prism Coin in Chapter 2 Level 9 to fix a clipping issue

 Adjusted Switch Cube timers on Chapter 2 Level 10

 Fixed a bug where Coin Collected percentage was not being calculated correctly

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 Released!
notes.content:
A new update for Grow Flow has been released, containing the following:


 Added three new achievements

 Added new progression icons to the Extras menu

 Began implementing par times (currently only for Chapter 1)

 Added a new Achievements menu

 Fixed a bug where certain Chapter 6 levels wouldn't autosave

 Fixed a bug where loading a save while inside an Unsafe Zone breaks Unsafe Zones entirely

 Fixed a bug where the number of the level was shown as zero on the tenth level of any given chapter

 Fixed one of Anna's animation on Chapter 2 Level 3 not looping properly

 Greatly optimized memory management in the Extras menu. Likely doesn't affect you in any way, but hey, i'm proud of it!


Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Major Update 0.9 Released!
notes.content:
We are launching a major update to Grow Flow! Thank you for keeping up with us and for supporting our game.

NEW in version 0.9:

 Added a new chapter to the game! Chapter 6 includes ten levels that will require a great mix of attention and precision.
 Added new Extras menu! Collect Prism Coins to unlock the extras. Unfortunately, the very first unlockable extra is not available yet, but do check out the other two!


Fixes and Tweaks:

 Fixed a bug where all the levels were unlocked from the get-go
 Made several tweaks to Chapter 3 level 6 on many sections that would previously require walljumping to get through
 Made a tweak to Chapter 1 Level 4 where you would likely die right after completing the level
 Fixed a bug in Chapter 5 Level 2 where several Switch Cubes were active and grown by default
 Fixed a bug where Anna's body color wasn't being animated properly in plenty of levels

notes.title: Update 0.8.3 Released!
notes.content:
We're releasing a new update, containing the following tweaks and fixes:


 Fixed a bug in Chapter 4 Level 9 where you couldn't save, and attempting to save would break the game
 
 Fixed the position of a Prism Coin in Chapter 4 Level 8
 
 Fixed Chapter 5 Level 10 completion taking you to the wrong level
 
 Fixed a cube in Chapter 4 Level 5 which had four times its intended size
 
 Fixed small object clipping issue in Chapter 5 Level 4
 
 Slightly moved an entire section from Chapter 5 Level 9 to prevent a clipping issue
 
 Added Level Select menu to the Pause Menu
 
 Added chapter-level number to the Pause Menu
 
 Fixed a glitch where some secrets were not interactable/obtainable
 
 Fixed a bug where a dying player would still be able to collect Prism Coins
 
 Hopefully fixed a Chapter 5 bug that, while not affecting anything in particular, would throw a lot of errors
 
 Added a bit of a better indicator to a certain alternate ending
 
 Added a message for quicksaving and quickloading
 
 Added quicksave and quickload to the "See Controls" Submenu
 
 Added a message for the Control Zones and Control Timed Zones, saying how many you still have to go
 
 Significantly improved the rendering of mirror reflections
 
 Fixed a glitch where a certain achievement would not trigger
 
 Fixed achievements not loading properly when opening the game (oops)
 
 The player is no longer able to save while dying or during important events, as well as loading during certain sequences
 
 Fixed a bug where the games fullscreen setting and resolution would reset after going back to the Main Menu - or at least i hope i fixed it
 
 Added a new achievement


Thank you all for you support and your reports!

notes.title: Update 0.8.2 Released!
notes.content:
A new Grow Flow update is out with the following changes:


 Tweaked Chapter 1 Level 5 to better introduce a game mechanic and improve the overall pacing
 
 Tweaked Chapter 2 Level 2, which had one red cube with four times its intended size
 
 Tweaked Chapter 4 Level 2, which was previously impossible due to an untested last minute change
 
 Fixed an issue with the game not letting you save in Chapter 2 Levels 6 and 7
 
 Significantly improved Anna's voice attenuation and panning, and also increased its volume
 
 Added Quick Saving and Loading (can be used by pressing f5 and f8 to save and load respectively)
 
 Added Extras Menu (which is currently completely empty)
 
 Tweaked Pause Menu to have a Quit Submenu
 
 Improved some of the code against possible future flaws


Thank you very much for all the feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 Released!
notes.content:
A new update is now out, which includes the following changes:


Added icon to Level 1, indicating that the player can't move or interact
Fixed timers not stopping once you load a save
Fixed Real Time timer not stopping and saving when you finish the game
Added a new achievement


Please report all the bugs you find!

notes.title: Grow Flow is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Grow Flow has been released and it is available for purchase!
Remember to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord server to share your experience with us!

Enjoy your play sessions!
- Chic

notes.title: Update Demo1.10 Released!
notes.content:
A new update for the Grow Flow demo is now out, containing the following:



 Fixed Level 2 not having any cube/zone animations

 Fixed minor menu glitch

Fixed ***two*** rendenring issues on the impulse cube

 Fixed a rendering mistake on the Eye's laser

 Completely reworked the AI (code-wise, not its functionality) of the Eye and its serialization (saving/loading)

 Almost completely remade the code for the ImpulseCube, as well as its serialization

 Fixed animation mistakes on ImpulseCube

 Made minor level design changes to levels 7 and 9



Remember to report bugs you find! You can do so by joining our Discord server, linked on our store page.

Furthermore, i would like to thank you all (Steam included!) once again for the Next Fest. Given the huge spike in our numbers, the event was nothing short of a massive success!

We have been publishing our demo's soundtrack to Youtube since the beginning of the Next Fest, and so here goes the four and last track: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DB_KnpChptU

notes.title: Update Demo1.09 Released!
notes.content:
The Demo Version 1.09 is out, mostly containing fixes to problems found during the first Next Fest presentation:


Fixed a cube on the first level having the wrong texture (my bad, i was testing the animations on it)

Fixed Density Cube not saving important flags/values and, consequentially, not loading properly

Fixed Antigrav Zone effect and sound not going away if you died while inside of it

Fixed bug where, if you died/restarted a level while in the middle of a single-click interactivity, the game would stop working


Be reminded that our second Steam Next Fest stream will be happening later today, at 2PM EST!

notes.title: Update Demo1.08 Released!
notes.content:
Version 1.08 is out, containing:


Fixed a rendering issue on Impulse Cube (for reals this time!)

Tweaked some of the textures in the game to better reflect the current artistical style of the game, as some of the textures were done very early on in development

Added (very minimal) animations to the minimalistic art style


Small changes i wanted to include before the Steam Next Fest, even tho the last update was supposed to be the final one before the event. 

In case you don't know, Grow Flow will be streamed on the 23rd and the 26th of this month, at 2pm EST, during the Next Fest, which showcases new and upcoming games launching in 2022. More information here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1825040/announcements/detail/4974790632779978185

notes.title: Update Demo1.07 Released!
notes.content:
The version 1.07 of the Grow Flow Demo is out now! Changes include:



Fixed a rendering issue on Impulse Cube

Fixed jitter in Hold-Click interactables when growing/shrinking

Made minor adjustments to level 9 (possibly the final level design adjustments in the demo)

Fixed infinite flight glitch (for the sixth time, damn it!)

The player now has death/respawn SFX feedback! (sorry! should've been here from the start)



This is supposed to be the final update for the next two or three weeks, but that may not be the case if some big issue is reported, or an important addition becomes priority.

notes.title: Update Demo1.06 Released!
notes.content:
Update Version 1.06 of the Grow Flow demo is now out, containing:


The interaction system of the game has been completely rewritten! This allows for click-interactables to be much easier to implement, fixes a couple bugs, optimizes the code and allows for new implementations such as the one below

The player's crosshair now changes when looking at an interactable object that is close enough to be interacted

Slightly changed the position of a Death Zone in level 8

Fixed Zones' rendering issues. As it turned out, their issues were actually related to caching/optimizations, so they had to be disabled

Fixed rendering issues regarding Density Cubes (the pink ones!)

Added a cursor to the game

notes.title: Update Demo1.05 Released!
notes.content:
The version 1.05 of the Grow Flow Demo is out! Changes include:


Level 3 was still missing a cube

Level 3's Normal Cubes now save properly

The "staircase" at the bottom of the fourth level now has more steps

Other minor changes to level design in levels 6 and 7

Move Cubes now work properly if you load them from a different level

Move Cubes load their state correctly (moving/stopped)

The player does not die if they load a save right before respawning anymore


Also, another issue has appeared: the player may become very slow after loading a save, thus needing to go back to the menu to fix itself.

On another note, the project has been updated to Unity 2021 and we'll be soon fixing the issues with the Zones rendering, mentioned in the previous update announcement.

notes.title: Update Demo1.04 Released!
notes.content:
The Grow Flow Demo has been updated to version 1.04!


Level 3 has been completely rebalanced by adding several Normal Cubes (the purple ones) around the stage

Level 5 is now beatable. Due to a misplaced trigger, the exit would be blocked by an invisible wall. Sorry!

Fixed a shader error in level 5

Doubled growing/shrinking speed for the Normal/Grow/Shrink cubes (purple/red/blue)


Note: There is a bug about the render queue of certain Zones: their internal part is sometimes being rendered on top of their external. We are already looking into possible fixes, don't worry!

notes.title: Update Demo1.03 Released!
notes.content:
The Version 1.03 of the Grow Flow demo is out! List of changes:


 Fixed a bug where the pause menu would disappear if you unpaused while in a sub-menu

 Changed options menu opening on the "See Controls" submenu if you unpaused on it

 Placed the animation trigger in level 2 to where it was supposed to be

 Game now starts windowed the first time

 Hopefully optimized loading times a tad bit


Additionally, the game is now nearly a gigabyte lighter. Thank you for reporting problems!

notes.title: Update Demo1.02 Released!
notes.content:
The Demo1.02 update is out! It contains the following changes:


 Added game logo to the pause menu

 Fixed being able to see the menu background before the Virus Team logo plays

 Controls are now informed in a submenu inside the options menu

The bug that lead to infinite flight on level transitions has been *mostly* fixed

 Fixed a bug related to interacting with cubes while changing level or dying. A tiny bug of this bug still persists, but it shouldn't affect the player experience

 Impulse Cube now has the correct texture

 Virus Team logo video should play correctly on all systems (although that hasn't been tested for sure. Please report back!)

notes.title: Update Demo1.01 Released!
notes.content:
We have launched the update version Demo1.01 for the demo, containing the following changes:


  Fixed minor mistake in one of the portraits

  Adjusted audio mixing and other settings in the options menu

  Cutscenes don't replay in the same level anymore (after they've fully played once). It will also save in the game's Save/Load feature

  Improved Anna's face animation in level 2

  Fixed a minor positioning mistake in level 2
